decisions.reason: Although GA4 remains relevant, a standalone tracking plugin no longer being marketed in 2024 suggests weak strategic fit versus bundling analytics implementation into the firm's broader e-commerce service projects.
A Google Universal Analytics plugin is obsolete by 2025 and no longer fits client needs, so continuing it would waste resources.

Because the retail system interface plugin was no longer mentioned in 2024, management would likely discontinue the standalone product and focus instead on custom integration work within client projects.
The shop relaunch SEO support service was still prominently presented in 2024 and directly matches the firm's core full-service e-commerce and conversion-focused positioning.
The SEO workshops were newly presented on their own page in 2024 and fit well as a scalable advisory offering that supports client acquisition and ongoing service sales.
